'''Get Eldin''' is a farmer in the [[Two Rivers]].

== Appearance ==
He is bald, leathery and wrinkle-faced and three times Perrin's age. {{Ref|{{twotc}}, Get Eldin}}

== Activities ==
Perrin has him prevent other Emond's Field residents from bothering [[Haral Luhhan]] at the forge.{{ref/book|4|45}}

He helps defend [[Emond's Field]] against the invading [[Trollocs]].
